Judgment And Award Dated 01.03.2018 Passed In Mvc
No.3743/2015 On The File Of The Viii Additional Scj &
Xxxiii Acmm, Member-Mact, Bengaluru [Scch-5],
Awarding Compensation Of Rs.3,55,000/- With Interest
@ 9% P.A. From The Date Of Petition Till Realization.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

1. The insurer is in appeal challenging the fastening of liability on it to pay the compensation of Rs.3,55,000/- on the ground that the driver of the offending vehicle did not possess a driving licence at all.

2. In the light of the judgment rendered in NATIONAL INSURANCE CO. LTD., V. CHALLA UPENDRA RAO AND OTHERS - AIR 2004 SC 4882, in cases where the insurer pleads breach of policy conditions, the insurer would nevertheless have to pay the compensation and thereafter proceed to recover same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

entities.text: NATIONAL INSURANCE CO. LTD., V. CHALLA UPENDRA RAO AND OTHERS - AIR 2004 SC 4882
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. In that view of the matter, the award directing the insurer to pay the compensation is affirmed and the liberty is reserved to the insurer to recover the said money from the owner of the offending vehicle.

4. As far as awarding of interest is concerned, the Tribunal has awarded interest at the rate of 9%
per annum.
In my view, it would be appropriate to hold that the claimant will be entitled to interest at the rate of 6% per annum on the compensation amount as against 9% awarded by the Tribunal.
Subject to the above, the appeal is dismissed.
